subject: [PATCH v2 2/4] kernfs: resume readdir on the full entry key

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs readdir functionality to resume reading at the full entry key, rather than just the hash value. This is necessary because two entries in one directory can share a hash, so the hash alone does not indicate where the listing stopped. The patch introduces a new parameter 'name' to the kernfs_dir_pos function, which allows it to search for the next entry after the given name. If the name matches an existing entry, the function returns that entry; otherwise, it falls back to searching by hash value. This change ensures that readdir operations are accurate and reliable even in cases where multiple entries share a common hash.
